message.title: Arribatec Group ASA: Arribatec selected as supplier to the United Kingdom Defence Equipment and Support
message.body:
Oslo, 10 November 2026 - Arribatec Group ASA (OSE: ARR) announces that its subsidiary Arribatec UK Ltd has been selected by Defence Equipment and Support (DE&S), the procurement and support organisation of the UK Ministry of Defence, to supply an Integrated Management System (IMS). 

The contract value is GBP 8,634,166 excluding VAT (GBP 10,361,000 including VAT). The estimated contract dates are 23 November 2026 to 23 November 2031. A further period of 3 (2+1) years can be applied to the contract to November 2034, and the contract includes the right to additional purchases while the contract is valid.

The IMS will house Defence Equipment and Support's Business Process Management System architecture and should be accessible to civil servants and industry partners, initially up to circa 15,000 users. It consists of an assurance management system and a business process improvement system. The solution is based on commercially available off-the-shelf (COTS) software and includes a formal service management support wrap with service level agreements.

The award is subject to a standstill period ending on 18 November 2026. The earliest date the contract will be signed is 19 November 2026.

For further information, please contact: 
Ole Jakob Kjølvik, CEO, Arribatec Group ASA, Tel: +47 915 98 935, Email: olejakob.kjolvik@arribatec.com 
Bent Hammer, CFO, Arribatec Group ASA, Tel: +47 982 15 497, Email: bent.hammer@arribatec.com

About Arribatec | www.arribatec.com
Arribatec is a software and consulting company headquartered in Oslo. Combining a customer-centric engagement model with deep system, integration and domain expertise, Arribatec builds long-term strategic partnerships across a broad customer base. The company employs over 250 people and is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange under the ticker ARR.
